items: About 20 new lines, most in your own words; three opening lines are my drafts (the CDO idea). About 20 lines cut (the treadmill speech, Bob's old speech, the therapy flourishes, the car-park insults).
The plea and the ending: next round, as you said.
Re-voice every new line: Nell about 10, Tarquin about 5, Bob about 6. No Suno credits.

plan.h: Picture, new (generated, then picked on a page)
items: About nine new shots: the City into the NatWest Tower; three trading-floor shots (Jack's two September stills first); Tarquin in the car worried; the car from outside; the wide Waitrose car park; Bob in the tent with the wank tank outside; Bob and Tarquin in one frame; 28 and 67 without the beer.
Cut the treadmill, the driving shot and the 58.5 s flash; move the locksmith shot; halve the trip with fades.
Go on the words? Change any line on its slip; then I voice them.
The three opening drafts (beat 0): keep, or run the dialogue-options tool for a few ranked versions.

replies.at230: Agreed (Kai: "CDOs is exactly correct… use all of that 2008-era language"). The bundles were mortgage-backed securities packaged into CDOs, stamped triple A by the ratings agencies; credit default swaps were the insurance written on them. Draft, over the trading-floor shots: "Tarquin here is buying CDOs. Collateralised debt obligations: other people's mortgages, sliced, diced, and stamped triple A by the ratings agencies." / "Nobody checks what's inside. Why would you?
